title: Siman 350
section: The Virtue of His Torah and His Holy Books

segments.he: (יא) שמעתי מפיו הקדוש שאמר שהתורה שלי היא כלה בחינות:
segments.en: (11.) I heard from his holy mouth that he said: "My Torah is entirely in the aspect of levels."
